scope: External sealed benchmark only. This file is an intake contract, NOT a generated attestation or proof.
candidate_model_and_prereg_sha: R5_FIT_SHA_TO_BE_TAKEN_FROM_R5_AUDIT; no silent training after frozen candidate
no_access_before_seal: no class/label reveals to JANUS before model freeze

required_fields.external_admin_identity: Organization, named accountable administrator, separately controlled account, signature public key; blanks mean not independent.
required_fields.sealed_manifest: Signed UTC timestamp + SHA256 of canonical manifest before sources or seeds revealed.
required_fields.unseen_originals: At least 20 sealed CNF originals in >=4 genuinely independent generator families, without overlap/isomorphism with R1-R5 training/test source SHA.
required_fields.instrumentation: CPU+RAM+wall limits; independent machine and provider; pinned solver versions and frozen model/script SHA; randomized trial order; repeat >=5 per arm per source; cold total-time includes original CNF parse/profiling/decision/model replay.
required_fields.baselines: CryptoMiniSat original, CryptoMiniSat native XOR only for certified full XOR, CaDiCaL original, optionally another modern independent SAT solver. No GF2 ablation in external gain denominator.
required_fields.verification: Independent verifier validates every SAT model against complete original CNF, and independently checks portable proofs for every UNSAT. Same-admin proof insufficient.
required_fields.results: All raw children incl timeouts, errors, unsupported tasks and failures, SHA256 source and binary hashes, UTC, resource measurements, signed final data manifest.
required_fields.acceptance: At least 2 independently held-out source families >=1.20x versus fastest verified external baseline with no >10% regret on ANY source in both independent environments. Required 5/5 correctness, no imputed performance from timeout. Different standard Ubuntu runners within one GitHub admin are not independent providers.
required_fields.anti_tuning: Frozen decision thresholds cannot be adjusted after any source reveal; newly tuned model requires a completely fresh sealed source cohort.
